services.desc: Maui's Most Incredible Snorkeling Trip Details 5 Hours – 7:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. Departing daily Occasionally Molokini weather can be a bit unpredictable. If that’s the case, we’ll sail to a snorkel destination that is safe and more suitable to conditions. About Molokini is one of Maui’s most incredible snorkeling destinations. The unique, crescent shaped crater is a natural marine preserve, and is home to over 250 species of tropical fish. services.name: 'Alihilani Sunset Sail
services.desc: Sail into Maui's amazing sunset Duration 2 Hours Departing daily About Embark on an extraordinary sunset sail with us aboard our vessel 'Alihilani. The name 'Alihilani captures the place where the horizon meets the sea, a vision we are excited to share with you. We will sail in the beautiful Au'Au inter-island channel, allowing for some incredible views of Maui while watching the sunset out at sea. With abundant room to relax on the forward trampolines and comfortable seating both around and under our spacious cabin, we invite you to relax and enjoy the sounds of the sea as we turn off our motors and raise our sails. From December to March prepare for the miraculous sight of humpback whales

services.name: Lahaina Community Sail
services.desc: Sail into Maui's Incredible Sunset DEPARTURE FROM LAHAINA HARBOR Meet us at the Lahaina Harbor Loading Dock 2 Hours Departing every Saturday About Join us aboard our flagship sailing catamarans, Paragon and Paragon II, for an unforgettable Maui sunset sail from Lahaina Harbor. Watching the sun set at sea in the glassy, miraculous ‘au’au Channel is like floating inside a sphere of color, surrounded by the islands of Maui, Lāna‘i, and Moloka‘i. Enjoy the best of performance sailing on Maui aboard our Conser 47 catamarans. With spacious trampolines, shaded cabin seating, and a professional crew, this is the ultimate Maui sunset cruise. services.name: 4th of July Fireworks Sail
services.desc: Witness Maui's Fireworks over the ocean About There is no better seat for Maui's 4th of July fireworks than the open ocean. Join us aboard Akialoa for an evening sail departing Ma'alaea Harbor at 8 pm, sailing out into the Au'au Channel as the sun goes down and the celebration begins. We'll anchor offshore Wailea Beach just in time for the 9 pm fireworks display, watching the show from the water with nothing between you and the sky. It's a front-row view you simply cannot get from shore. While aboard, enjoy live music, a spread of appetizers, and an open bar featuring local beer, white wine, and island cocktails. faq.q: o you have snorkel gear on board?
faq.a: Yes. We provide snorkel gear and will fit you for correct size. We also have a few optical masks on board, so let us know if you require one and we’ll do our best to accommodate you. If you wish to bring your own gear you are more than welcome. Should we bring our own towels? Please do. Sail Maui does not provide towels, however we do keep a small inventory on the boat for purchase. Is there anything else we should bring?
